summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation done so far (read-only)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `server.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / schema. Findings:  - **Client** (`WatchlistPage.tsx`, `api.ts`): fetches/saves via `/api/watchlist*` with `credentials: "include"`, no localStorage/anonymous fallback, page is gated behind auth in `App.tsx`. Looks correct. - **Server** (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`): every route resolves `userId` via a router-level auth middleware that reads the `arca_session` cookie → `getSession(token)` → sets `X-User-Id`. Every query
